stem: A pollen-producing structure is documented on one plant in a flowering room. Which record best supports later risk assessment without overstating what is known?
choices: Record the source plant and structure, location and time, nearby susceptible reproductive tissues, relevant handling or airflow context, and whether pollen release or seed development was actually observed
Record that every plant in the room is pollinated
Record that one environmental stress definitely caused the structure
Record only the cultivar name because reproductive morphology is unnecessary
rationale: A defensible pollination-risk record separates observed source, possible pathway, susceptible target, and evidence of outcome. Presence of a pollen-producing structure does not by itself prove room-wide pollination or establish one cause.
